title: 第17章 立即跟我滚过来第18章 你是准备撬我墙角吗
lines: 第17章立即跟我滚过来
只是从出口一出来，夏天便瞄到接机处一群白色衣服的人，有些不解。
“怎么还有医生在这儿？”莫不是出了什么事情了？
权天睿只是深深的看了一眼夏天，没有说话，只是脚下的步子加快了几分，直接抱着夏天就朝那群医生走去。
夏天瞪大了双眼，也顾不得害羞了，连忙抬起头来看向权天睿。
“不会是等我们的吧？”
瞧着夏天猜对了，权天睿也不否认，但是纠正的说道：“不是等我们，是等你。”
夏天瞄了瞄自己的已经肿的老大的脚踝，好吧！
不过这架势会不会太足了点，直接弄了一个医疗队来。
显然，就算在弄一个医疗队来，他都不会嫌多。
对此，夏天选择闭嘴。
来来往往的机场的人是不少，自然有人认得权天睿，更何况这个男人不论走到哪里，都是自带光芒，让人移不开眼。
见到一向不近女色的权天睿，权少，居然抱着一个女人出现，这简直是惊天的新闻。
当然，这一切权天睿自然是不会在意，而夏天，根本就是没有想到明天的新闻头条就是自己。
那群医生，见权天睿抱着夏天走过来，显然也是有些吃惊，不过也是惊讶了瞬间而已。
本来权天睿是打算就在这里给夏天看下脚的，毕竟肿的那么大，他也不想在拖延下去。
李锦自然也是察觉到周围那些人的指指点点，连忙走了上来。
“boss，要不先去最近的医院，或者去最近的酒店也可以。”
权天睿冷眸扫过那些眼睛恨不得黏上来的人，蹙眉。
没有多余的话，直接抱着夏天便朝机场外面走去。
对于权少的决定，自然没有人有异议。
最近的一家私人医院里，被权天睿一群人浩浩荡荡的闯了进来，纷纷感到无比的好奇，而且更好奇的，居然是院长亲自迎接的。
都在猜测来的人是谁，居然有这么大的面子。
而此刻的夏天，根本没有心思在意这些。
脚踝的落在这群医生的手里，简直痛的她冷汗直冒。
随着夏天的每一声痛呼，权天睿的眸色便越发的冷了几分。
冰冷的眸子，像是是刀子一般，让那群医生，心惊胆寒。
“给我滚……”
“李锦，打电话叫苏万赫给我滚过来。”
权天睿紧紧的捏着双拳，那模样，像是濒临暴怒的狮子一般，让在场的人心肝都止不住的抖了抖。
最后权天睿的那个滚字对于他们来说，简直就是特赦一样。
相对于其他人的惧怕，李锦显然显得比较淡定点，开玩笑，要是心里承受力不大一点，在boss身边的话，被吓死那是迟早的事情。
心里却在叹气，这群人可是H城最顶级的外科医生了，都惹得boss不高兴了，可见他对少夫人的珍视程度。
不在多言，立即去给苏万赫打了电话。
只是此刻正在美人怀里的苏万赫，哪里肯卖李锦的面子？
content_en:
Chapter 17 Come here with me immediately
As soon as he came out of the exit, Xia Tian saw a group of people in white clothes at the pick-up area, and was a little confused.
"Why is there still a doctor here?" Could something have happened?
Quan Tianrui just took a deep look at Xia Xia and said nothing. He just accelerated his pace a little, hugged Xia Tian and walked towards the group of doctors.
Xia Tian's eyes widened, and he couldn't care less about being shy. He quickly raised his head and looked at Quan Tianrui.
"You're not waiting for us, are you?"
Seeing that Xia Tian guessed correctly, Quan Tianrui did not deny it, but corrected him and said: "It's not waiting for us, it's waiting for you."
Xia Tian glanced at his already swollen ankle, okay!
But is this stance a bit too much? I just brought in a medical team.
Obviously, even if he brings in a medical team, he won't have too many.
In this regard, Xia Tian chose to shut up.
There are a lot of people coming and going at the airport, so naturally some people recognize Quan Tianrui, not to mention that no matter where he goes, this man always shines with his own light, making people unable to take their eyes away.
Seeing Quan Tianrui, who has never been a womanizer, Mr. Quan actually appeared with a woman in his arms, this was simply shocking news.
Of course, Quan Tianrui would not care about all this, and Xia Tian simply did not expect that he would be the headline of tomorrow's news.
The group of doctors were obviously a little surprised when they saw Quan Tianrui coming over with Xia Tian in his arms, but they were only surprised for a moment.
Originally, Quan Tianrui planned to show Xia Tian's feet here. After all, the swelling was so big, and he didn't want to delay it any longer.
Li Jin naturally noticed the pointing fingers of those around him and walked up quickly.
"Boss, why don't you go to the nearest hospital first, or go to the nearest hotel."
Quan Tianrui glanced at those people whose eyes were eager to be glued to them, and frowned.
"Well..."
If there was nothing more to say, he just hugged Xia Tian and walked towards the outside of the airport.
Naturally, no one had any objection to Shao Quan's decision.
In a recent private hospital, Quan Tianrui's group of people burst in. They all felt extremely curious, and what was even more curious was that they were greeted by the dean himself.
Everyone was guessing who the person who came was actually so prestigious.
At this moment, Xia Tian has no intention to care about this at all.
The pain in the hands of these doctors made her break into a cold sweat.
"Ah...it hurts, it hurts..."
With Xia Tian's every cry of pain, Quan Tianrui's eyes became colder.
His cold eyes, like knives, made the doctors terrified.
"Get out of here..."
"Li Jin, call Su Wanhe and get here."
Quan Tianrui clenched his fists tightly, like a lion on the verge of rage, which made everyone present tremble uncontrollably.
In the end, Quan Tianrui's "roll" sign was like an amnesty to them.
Compared to other people's fears, Li Jin was obviously calmer. Just kidding, if you don't have enough endurance in your heart, it would be a matter of time before you were scared to death when you were around the boss.
"Yes..."
But I was sighing in my heart. These people were the top surgeons in H City, and they had made the boss unhappy, which showed how much he valued the young lady.
Without further ado, he immediately called Su Wanhe.
It's just that Su Wanhe, who is in the arms of the beauty at this moment, is willing to sell Li Jin's face?
title_en: Chapter 17 Come with me immediately Chapter 18 Are you ready to pry me into a corner?
